## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes, or I explained why it was not run.
- [ ] New policy, redaction, retrieval, or evidence behavior has tests.
- [ ] Examples, fixtures, screenshots, and docs use synthetic data only.
- [ ] Blocked chunk text still cannot reach the model or public API response.
- [ ] Documentation stays explicit about MVP scope and limitations.

## Notes

Call out any follow-up work, known limitations, or release implications.
